note: runs_root holds full run folders (large); results_root receives compact results exported after each site. Relative paths are resolved from the repository root. NET2CELL_RUNS_ROOT / NET2CELL_RESULTS_ROOT override. dashboard_root holds the dashboard's map library (vendor/) and the built page, dashboard_template is the page it is built from (NET2CELL_DASHBOARD_ROOT / NET2CELL_DASHBOARD_TEMPLATE override them).
